purpose: External open-source projects and APIs that produce JSON feeds of copy trader/leaderboard data on a recurring schedule. Goal: leverage these instead of building our own scrapers for hard-to-scrape platforms.

tier1_high_value_repos.name: binance-copy-trade-bot
tier1_high_value_repos.data_provided: Scrapes Binance Futures Leaderboard trader positions in real-time via undocumented bapi endpoints. Monitors position opens/closes for followed traders. Stores in MongoDB.
tier1_high_value_repos.integration_approach: Reference their API endpoint documentation. They reverse-engineered the Binance bapi/ endpoints. Use their endpoint patterns in our own scanner. Key endpoints: /bapi/futures/v2/public/future/leaderboard/getOtherPosition, /bapi/futures/v1/public/future/leaderboard/searchLeaderboard
tier1_high_value_repos.notes: Most popular Binance leaderboard project. Actively maintained as of Mar 2026. Requires cookie refresh every 2-3 days for Binance API access.

tier1_high_value_repos.name: binance-futures-bapi
tier1_high_value_repos.data_provided: Complete API documentation for Binance Futures Leaderboard undocumented endpoints. Trader search, rankings, positions, PNL history.
tier1_high_value_repos.integration_approach: USE AS REFERENCE for our Binance scraper. Documents all bapi endpoints that people charge $30/month for. Free documentation of the full API surface.
tier1_high_value_repos.notes: Pure gold — free API docs that commercial services sell. GPL-3.0 licensed.

tier1_high_value_repos.name: hyperliquid-python-sdk (Official)
tier1_high_value_repos.data_provided: Official SDK. clearinghouseState endpoint gives any user's open positions by wallet address. No auth required for read-only info endpoints. POST to https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info with type=clearinghouseState.
tier1_high_value_repos.update_frequency: Real-time API (no auth needed for reads)
tier1_high_value_repos.integration_approach: pip install hyperliquid-python-sdk. Query top leaderboard wallets' positions directly. Combine with our _hl_deep_research.json wallet list. FREE, NO API KEY NEEDED for info endpoints.
tier1_high_value_repos.notes: Best data source for DeFi perp positions. Official, well-maintained, MIT licensed. 1469 stars.

tier1_high_value_repos.name: ok24601/etoro-api
tier1_high_value_repos.data_provided: Full eToro REST API wrapper. Can query Popular Investor portfolios, positions, watchlists. Supports IsPopularInvestor=true filter.
tier1_high_value_repos.integration_approach: Could call from our scanner to get eToro Popular Investor positions. Requires eToro account credentials. Selenium-based auth.
tier1_high_value_repos.notes: Most starred eToro API project. ISC license (permissive). Requires Chrome/Selenium for auth.

tier1_high_value_repos.name: mkhaled87/etoro-api
tier1_high_value_repos.data_provided: Python API auto-generated from eToro OpenAPI specs. Access to discovery endpoint (Popular Investors), portfolio data, user trades.
tier1_high_value_repos.integration_approach: pip install. Query Popular Investor discovery endpoint for top trader portfolios. More Pythonic than the Kotlin version.
tier1_high_value_repos.notes: Auto-generated from official OpenAPI spec — comprehensive coverage.

tier2_useful_repos.name: bukowa/binance-leaderboard
tier2_useful_repos.data_provided: Was producing daily JSON dump of Binance leaderboard traders at raw.githubusercontent.com URL. Contains encryptedUid, PNL, ROI, followerCount, positionShared flag.
tier2_useful_repos.update_frequency: STALE — GitHub Actions cron disabled March 2024. Last data update Jan 2024.
tier2_useful_repos.integration_approach: Fork and re-enable the cron workflow. The scraping code still works. Or use their approach in our own scanner.
tier2_useful_repos.notes: Good template for GitHub Actions-based leaderboard scraping. Data format matches Binance API exactly.

tier2_useful_repos.name: Archento/Binance-Leaderboard-Scraper
tier2_useful_repos.data_provided: Template bot that checks predefined traders for open positions on Binance leaderboard.
tier2_useful_repos.integration_approach: Reference code for Binance leaderboard position scraping. Unlicense = free to use.
tier2_useful_repos.notes: Public domain — can freely copy code.

tier2_useful_repos.name: Nunnito/Binance-Futures-Leaderboard-API
tier2_useful_repos.data_provided: FastAPI wrapper around Binance leaderboard. Advanced search with filters: symbols, period, sort by PNL/ROI, USDM/COINM. Hosted on RapidAPI.
tier2_useful_repos.integration_approach: Reference their FastAPI endpoint patterns. Or use RapidAPI if still active.

tier2_useful_repos.name: GTedZ/binance-leaderboard
tier2_useful_repos.data_provided: JavaScript library for Binance Leaderboard API. Methods for search, positions, rankings.
tier2_useful_repos.notes: Clean JS library. Could port to Python.

tier2_useful_repos.name: Leo4815162342/myfxbook-api-client
tier2_useful_repos.data_provided: MyFxBook API client. Access to: daily gains, trade history, open positions, community outlook, data-daily for any public MyFxBook account.
tier2_useful_repos.integration_approach: MyFxBook API is FREE and returns JSON. Endpoints: /api/get-daily-gain.json, /api/get-history.json, /api/get-community-outlook.json. No scraping needed — official API.
tier2_useful_repos.notes: MyFxBook has an official free JSON API at myfxbook.com/api. Can get any public account's full trade history.

tier2_useful_repos.name: weirdapps/etorotrade
tier2_useful_repos.data_provided: Portfolio screener/tracker by an eToro Popular Investor. Provides BUY/SELL/HOLD analysis for positions.
tier2_useful_repos.integration_approach: MIT licensed. Reference their eToro data extraction approach.
tier2_useful_repos.notes: Built by an actual eToro Popular Investor. Very actively maintained.

tier2_useful_repos.name: hyperliquid-leaderboard-backtest
tier2_useful_repos.data_provided: Queries top 100 Hyperliquid traders by PNL every 5 minutes. Tracks BTC/ETH positions. Includes correlation analysis of positions vs price movements.
tier2_useful_repos.integration_approach: Reference their leaderboard query approach. They use the official Hyperliquid API. Could adapt their position tracking logic.
tier2_useful_repos.notes: Interesting backtesting angle — proves whether top trader positions predict price moves.

tier2_useful_repos.name: penguinsolver/hyperliquid_leaderboard_tracker
tier2_useful_repos.data_provided: Identifies profitable traders and tracks their positions on Hyperliquid.
tier2_useful_repos.integration_approach: Reference implementation for HL leaderboard tracking.
tier2_useful_repos.notes: Focused specifically on identifying and tracking profitable traders.

key_finding: The biggest gap in the ecosystem is that NO open-source project produces a regularly-updated JSON feed of multi-exchange copy trader data. Individual platform scrapers exist but are fragmented. Our copy_trader_intel system is actually one of the most comprehensive aggregators — the main improvement opportunity is (1) using official free APIs where available (Hyperliquid, MyFxBook) instead of fragile scraping, and (2) integrating Copin.io API to fix 3 empty data sources.
